name: Morikawa Naoharu
source:
Recurring character.

A young detective who works under [url=/c123791]Himuro Yutaka[/url]. Contrary to his superior, Naoharu is a hot-blooded man with a serious personality and is sometimes inflexible. He thinks that solving cases is the job of the police, and he doesn't trust private detectives. For some reason, each time he meets [url=/c123784]Kyousuke[/url] at the scene of a crime, they fight with each other.

[Translated from [url=https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/MISSING_PARTS_the_TANTEI_STORIES]Wikipedia[/url].]
